in_hebrew.name: יִשְׁמוּל
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The name Ishmul is derived from the Hebrew roots 'yesh' (יש) meaning 'God', and 'shamal' (שמול) meaning 'reward'. Thus, Ishmul means 'God is my reward'.

in_greek.name: Ishmul
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει God of Ishmael
in_greek.long_meaning: Ishmul είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Hebrew elements ‘esh’ (God) and ‘shamel’ (God of Ishmael), this name is a biblical given name that honors the deity revered by Ishmael, the elder son of Abraham and Hagar.

in_latin.name: Ishmul
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat God of Ishmael
in_latin.long_meaning: Ishmul est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Hebrew elements ‘esh’ (God) and ‘shamel’ (God of Ishmael), this name is a biblical given name that honors the deity revered by Ishmael, the elder son of Abraham and Hagar.
